title: Changelog streams
description: changelog/streams.json. The file may hold the list itself or the same list under a `streams` key.

$schema.description: Editor hint only, pointing at this file. The server ignores it.

list.description: Streams, in the order they should be listed, featured ones first. Leave the file out rather than emptying it.

name.description: Directory under changelog/, and the {stream} segment of the URL. Lowercase, digits and dashes only.

id.description: Defaults to the position in the list.

display_name.description: Shown by the client. Defaults to `name`.

is_featured.description: Featured streams are listed before the others.
